effects.effect: You can use and gain the benefits of a stormwight kit (see [Stormwight Kits](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.stormwight-kits/kit-features)). Your stormwight kit grants you a number of benefits, including benefits tied to your [Growing Ferocity](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.boren/growing-ferocity) feature.
